source: Codex re-probe c2 (steer during a running tool), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; tool wait not replayed

params.prompt: Run the shell command sleep 12. After it finishes, say the word BASE.

steer.text: Also include token VIA_STEER_159 in your final answer.

expect.notes: turn/steer with the active turn's id returns {turnId} equal to it: Injected, one steer.delivered, and no second turn/start (vendors/codex.md §3 Steer). A steer whose expected vendor turn is stale gets -32600 `expected active turn id ... but found ...`, mapped from that text to turn_mismatch (C1 §3.4; vendors/codex.md §3: every refusal is -32600, so the mapping uses the operation, the expected id and the message). expected_vendor_turn null means the driver's own active turn id. The steer text appears as a userMessage item and is not final text.
